snippet.title: Dodo Duckie - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description:
Waddle into a reality-bending odyssey where simply being a duck is your greatest superpower. With the help of your magical cap, switch instantly between 2D and 3D to uncover hidden paths, outsmart aliens, and rescue your kidnapped chicken friends in Dodo Duckie. Get another look at gameplay from Dodo Duckie in this latest trailer for the wholesome puzzle platformer adventure. 

Dodo Duckie is available now on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Steam, and Epic Games Store.
